<thought>Based on the molecular ion (m/z 179.0946) the formula is C10H13NO2. The ¹H NMR shows a para‑substituted aromatic ring (two doublets, 2 H each), a methoxy singlet (3 H) and two equivalent –CH₂–CH₂– triplets (2 H each) adjacent to the aromatic ring and a carbonyl, consistent with 4‑methoxy‑phenyl‑propionamide. The SMILES for this structure is COc1ccc(cc1)CCC(=O)N.</thought>
